herring.title: Herring
herring.description:
My glass herring and hooligan are an ode to these keystone species of fish in Southeast Alaska. Herring
and Hooligan (Eulachon) are integral to the communities and wildlife throughout Alaska; I seek to
highlight the importance of these critical forage fish as well as to illuminate the dire ecological and
environmental changes that are impacting these species.
Every glass fish I create is designed from scientific research photos and personal catches. They are all
created from waste window glass and are true to size, scale, and have the physical properties of the
herring and hooligan caught in SE AK. Each individual fish is cut from multiple layers of window glass,
hand printed and assembled with metal inclusions before kiln fusing. The herring and hooligan are
designed to be suspended from their heads and/or tails and can be hung outside except for in the
winter where they are susceptible to freeze/thaw cycles and will break.
With this work I hope to readily engage and educate the public on environmental issues facing forage
fish in Alaska, illuminating these issues through artistic interpretation and a stunning visual language
which is accessible to all. Not to mention they are easily packable and can provide remembrances of
Alaska for years to come. I hope you enjoy having my work in your collection!
